reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `upstream_request_rejected`: USDM rejects a selector or date request. `staging_busy`: The bounded acquisition admission slots are occupied. `ambiguous_area`: Several exact names match. `unknown_area`: The state name cannot resolve. `invalid_area`: State is used with the wrong scope. `invalid_date_range`: Dates are impossible or baseline follows target. `publication_unavailable`: No latest publication is available. `dataset_too_large`: The complete request exceeds acquisition or metadata budgets. `upstream_shape_invalid`: Upstream data is malformed, duplicate or outside scope. `canvas_unavailable`: A complete ranking requires an unavailable analytical provider. `staging_capacity_exhausted`: Retained analytical capacity is exhausted. `canvas_not_found`: The supplied canvas is absent or expired. `canvas_capacity_exhausted`: The provider cannot mint another canvas. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.
